hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/ui" 2>/dev/null && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg msg "eslint found issues in $(basename "$f"):
$out" '{systemMessage:$msg, hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse", additionalContext:$msg}}'; fi ;; esac
